title: Price a contract in the years it is paid
heading: Escalation Turns a Price Quoted in One Year Into the Price Paid in Another
cases: with no escalation, the k-th year of work is billed in calendar year start + k at its quoted amount
work starting after the price-book year is escalated for every year since the price book, not since the start
an amount billed in the price-book year itself is not escalated
